items.title: SkillShield: Prompt-Space Security Skills for LLM Coding Agents
items.summary: A coding agent edits files and executes shell commands with its developer's privileges, allowing malicious requests to translate directly into harmful actions or functional malware. Existing defenses have complementary limitations: weight-level alignment is unavailable to API-only deployers, whereas input filters and execution-boundary monitors require auxiliary classification or checking components along the agent's trajectory. We therefore introduce SkillShield, a system-prompt defense that synthesizes security skills offline from known attacks or recorded agent failures. These skills are injected into the system prompt at session start and remain active throughout the tool-use loop. Unlike a reference monitor, they protect the system by defining the security policies the model should follow during execution. Due to the limited system-prompt space, we examine three fixed-budget provisioning scopes: all-classes, with one skill covering all threat classes, per-bundle, with one skill targeting a related subset, and per-class, with one skill dedicated to a single known class and used as the upper-bound reference. None requires runtime request classification or routing. Across six large language models on RedCode, the default all-classes skill reduces malware-generation severity from 3.37 to 0.58 and achieves a 43.6% execution attack success rate, comparable to Llama Guard 3's 42.7% without its separate 8B classifier. The per-bundle and class-fixed per-class settings further reduce this rate to 36.2% and 14.5%, respectively. Under two non-adaptive jailbreak families, SkillShield continues to outperform all baselines on malware generation. Across 731 benign task descriptions, SkillShield yields a mean safety-refusal rate of 0.14%. These results demonstrate the potential of prompt-space security skills to prevent harmful actions and malware generation for LLM coding agents.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 SkillShield，一种面向 LLM 编程代理（coding agent）的提示空间安全防御方法。此类代理拥有开发者的文件读写与 shell 执行权限，恶意指令可能直接导致有害操作或功能型恶意软件生成。现有防御存在互补性局限：基于权重对齐的安全对齐不适用于仅通过 API 部署的模型；输入过滤器和执行边界监控需要额外的分类或检测组件沿代理运行轨迹进行辅助判断。SkillShield 从已知攻击或记录的代理失败事例中离线合成安全技能（security skills），在会话开始时注入系统提示中，并在整个工具调用循环内保持生效。与传统的引用监视器（reference monitor）不同，它通过定义模型在执行过程中应遵循的安全策略来保护系统。由于系统提示空间有限，论文研究三种固定预算的供给范围：全类别（all-classes，一个技能覆盖所有威胁类别）、分束（per-bundle，一个技能针对相关子集）、逐类别（per-class，一个技能专用于单个已知类别，作为上界参考）。所有这些方案均无需运行时请求分类或路由。在 RedCode 基准上对六个大语言模型进行实验：默认的全类别技能将恶意软件生成严重性从 3.37 降至 0.58，并将执行攻击成功率降至 43.6%，与 Llama Guard 3 的 42.7% 相当，但无需额外的 8B 分类器；分束和逐类别设置进一步将成功率降至 36.2% 和 14.5%。在两种非自适应越狱家族下，SkillShield 在恶意软件生成方面仍优于所有基线。在 731 个良性任务描述中，SkillShield 的平均安全拒绝率为 0.14%。实验证明提示空间安全技能在防止 LLM 编程代理产生有害行为和恶意软件方面具有潜力。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 编程代理因具备高权限工具访问能力而被视为高风险组件。SkillShield 仅通过修改系统提示即可实现显著防护，无需额外推理成本或模型权重，对 API-only 部署方尤其可行，为蓝队提供了一种轻量、可部署的防御思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于采用 LLM coding agent 的开发环境、CI/CD 流水线或任何授予代理文件与 shell 权限的场景，可降低恶意指令引发的代码注入、恶意软件生成和有害操作风险。但实际效果依赖于基础模型对提示的遵循能力。

items.title: Closing the Gap: Automated Discovery of Secure Dockerfile Reference Standards via Semantic Clustering in Enterprise Inner Source
items.summary: Containerization dominates enterprise software delivery, yet Dockerfiles that assemble container images frequently harbor security misconfigurations and structural technical debt. This problem is poorly understood in corporate inner-source environments, where proprietary context and isolated governance prevent direct application of open-source findings. We present an automated, six-stage pipeline that: (1) crawls an enterprise GitLab instance, (2) enriches each Dockerfile with static security and quality metrics (Hadolint, ShellCheck, Trivy) and lifecycle data, (3) groups functionally identical workloads using LLM-generated semantic descriptions and HDBSCAN, and (4) quantifies the optimization gap against cluster-internal reference implementations. Applied to 11,470 Dockerfiles from over 6,200 repositories at a single large industrial company, we find a systemic deficit: 99\% of files contain at least one security misconfiguration, 80.8\% violate Dockerfile best practices, and the median artifact has not been revised for 838~days. Despite this, high-quality reference implementations already exist within 83\% of functional clusters. Adopting these internal standards would increase the average security posture score by 60.4\% without developing any new templates. These findings, grounded in one organization's inner-source ecosystem, provide a data-driven foundation for future automated, context-aware recommender systems targeting enterprise supply-chain security; whether the observed technical-debt distribution and optimization gap generalize to other enterprises remains an open question for future multi-organization study.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对企业内源（inner source）环境中 Dockerfile 安全配置缺失与技术债务普遍存在的问题展开研究。在大型企业的内部代码仓库中，由于专有上下文和隔离的治理机制，直接套用开源社区的安全发现往往不可行。作者构建了一个六阶段自动化流水线：首先爬取企业 GitLab 实例中的全部 Dockerfile；接着利用 Hadolint、ShellCheck、Trivy 等静态分析工具对每个文件进行安全与质量评分，并补充生命周期数据；然后借助大语言模型（LLM）生成语义描述，配合 HDBSCAN 聚类算法将功能相同的工作负载归组；最后量化每个集群内部实现相对最优参考实现的差距。该方法被应用于一家大型工业公司的 6,200 余个仓库中的 11,470 个 Dockerfile。结果显示，99% 的文件至少包含一种安全错误配置，80.8% 违反 Dockerfile 最佳实践，中位制品已持续 838 天未修订，暴露出系统性技术债务。然而，在 83% 的功能集群中已经存在高质量参考实现。如果采用这些内部标准，无需开发任何新模板即可将平均安全态势评分提升 60.4%。该研究为未来构建自动化、上下文感知的企业供应链安全推荐系统提供了数据驱动的基础。作者同时指出，技术债分布与优化差距是否能推广至其他企业，尚需多组织研究验证。

items.title: NeuronFuzz: Safety Neuron Guided Fuzzing for LLM Safety Evaluation
items.summary: Safety evaluation is critical for assessing whether aligned Large Language Models (LLMs) remain robust against jailbreak attacks. Existing automated testing methods, however, largely rely on response-level feedback: each candidate prompt typically requires generating a target-model response to evaluate its attack effectiveness. This process is expensive and, more importantly, provides only sparse guidance on strongly aligned models, where most candidates are rejected with the same failure outcome. This paper presents NeuronFuzz, a white-box fuzzing framework that exploits internal safety neurons as continuous execution feedback for LLM safety evaluation. A SafetyOracle converts safety-neuron activations into a continuous safety alarm score that serves as feedback for fuzzing and can be obtained during prefill, eliminating response generation from the fuzzing loop. To construct the SafetyOracle, NeuronFuzz uses template-invariant harmful and benign inputs and stability-aware selection to identify a compact set of safety neurons whose activations capture harmful-intent recognition. Moreover, since the safety alarm score is differentiable, NeuronFuzz uses its gradients to identify safety-sensitive template positions and a masked language model to generate fluent, context-compatible mutations while preserving original harmful payload and avoiding additional optimization variables. We evaluate NeuronFuzz across 21 text and multimodal models. Across five white-box source models, it achieves a 76-100% jailbreak discovery rate, outperforming baselines by up to 48 percentage points. Its optimized templates further transfer zero-shot to open-weight and six proprietary target models, achieving average ASR and top-5 ensemble ASR (EASR) of 69.6%/92.6% and 44.1%/60.0%, respectively.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 NeuronFuzz，一个面向大语言模型（LLM）安全评估的白盒模糊测试框架。研究背景在于：现有针对越狱攻击的自动化测试方法大多依赖响应级反馈，即每个候选提示词都需要让目标模型生成完整回复来评估攻击是否成功。这一过程计算开销大，且在强对齐模型上反馈信号稀疏——大量候选都被同样拒绝，难以提供有效的指导信号。NeuronFuzz 的核心思想是利用模型内部的安全神经元激活值作为连续的执行反馈，替代昂贵的响应生成。作者设计了一个 SafetyOracle 模块，通过模板不变的恶意/良性输入和稳定性感知选择，识别出一组紧凑的安全神经元，并将其激活值转换为连续的安全警报分数。该分数可在预填充阶段获取，从而将响应生成从模糊测试循环中移除。由于该分数可微，NeuronFuzz 利用梯度定位对安全敏感的模板位置，并通过掩码语言模型生成流畅且上下文兼容的变异，同时保留原有恶意载荷，避免引入额外优化变量。实验覆盖 21 个文本和多模态模型：在 5 个白盒源模型上实现了 76%–100% 的越狱发现率，比基线高出最多 48 个百分点；优化后的模板能够零样本迁移到开放权重模型和 6 个专有目标模型，平均攻击成功率（ASR）与 top-5 集成 ASR 分别达到 69.6%/92.6% 和 44.1%/60.0%。该工作为 LLM 安全评估提供了一种高效的白盒方法，特别适合需要大规模、低成本评估模型鲁棒性的场景。适合安全研究人员、模型评测团队和 LLM 安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 传统越狱测试依赖完整响应生成，成本高且反馈稀疏。NeuronFuzz 首次利用安全神经元激活作为连续反馈，大幅提升白盒越狱发现的效率和迁移性，为 LLM 安全评估提供了新范式。

items.title: Are LLM-Enhanced GNNs Privacy-Safe?
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently advanced graph neural networks (GNNs) by enriching node representations with semantic information, giving rise to LLM-enhanced GNNs that achieve substantial performance gains. However, their vulnerability to privacy attacks, in which adversaries infer sensitive information from model outputs, remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic evaluation of privacy risks in LLM-enhanced GNNs through a unified framework consisting of five stages: (1) dataset preparation, (2) victim model training, (3) privacy attack, (4) risk assessment, and (5) defense analysis. Specifically, we conduct experiments on six real-world text-attributed graph datasets covering diverse domains. We consider six representative privacy attack methods targeting three fundamental threats, namely link, label, and membership inference, and construct 42 victim model configurations by combining multiple LLM-based feature enhancers with representative GNN backbones. Extensive experiments show that, despite their utility improvements, LLM-enhanced GNNs consistently exhibit increased vulnerability to privacy attacks compared to shallow text representation baselines. Further analysis reveals that semantic enrichment amplifies link-, label-, and membership-related signals in the embedding space, making them more exploitable by inference attacks. Finally, we evaluate differential privacy as a defense strategy and show that, while it can partially mitigate privacy risks, it introduces significant utility degradation, highlighting a fundamental privacy-utility trade-off in LLM-enhanced graph learning. Overall, this work provides a comprehensive understanding of privacy risks in LLM-enhanced GNNs and offers practical insights for developing more secure and trustworthy graph learning systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究（arXiv论文“Are LLM-Enhanced GNNs Privacy-Safe?”）系统性地评估了LLM增强图神经网络（GNN）在隐私攻击面前的脆弱性。近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）通过向图节点表示中注入语义信息，显著提升了GNN的性能，催生了LLM-enhanced GNN这一新兴范式。然而，此类模型在下游任务中可能遭受隐私攻击——攻击者可从模型输出中推断敏感信息，这一问题此前缺乏系统研究。为填补空白，作者提出了一个包含五个阶段的统一评估框架：数据集准备、受害者模型训练、隐私攻击、风险评估与防御分析。他们在六个真实世界文本属性图数据集上展开实验，覆盖不同领域；并选择了六种代表性隐私攻击方法，针对三类基本威胁：链接推理、属性/标签推理和成员推理。通过将多种基于LLM的特征增强器与典型GNN骨干组合，构造了42种受害者模型配置。大量实验表明：尽管LLM增强提升了模型效用，但这些模型相比于浅层文本表示基线，持续地表现出更高的隐私攻击脆弱性。进一步分析揭示，语义增强在嵌入空间中放大了与链接、标签和成员相关的信号，使得推理攻击更易提取敏感信息。最后，作者评估了差分隐私作为防御手段的效果，发现它只能部分缓解隐私风险，却会带来显著的效用损失，突显了LLM增强图学习中的根本性隐私-效用权衡。该工作为理解LLM-enhanced GNN的隐私风险提供了全面认识，并为构建更安全可信的图学习系统提供了实践见解。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM增强GNN在社交网络、推荐系统等领域应用广泛，但隐私风险尚未被充分认知。本研究表明这类模型比传统方法更容易遭受链接、标签和成员隐私推理攻击，安全团队需评估自身图学习系统的隐私暴露面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用文本属性图进行节点分类等任务的LLM-GNN系统，尤其涉及用户敏感关系的社交网络、知识图谱场景。

在部署前进行隐私风险评估

items.title: Reassembling Distributed Risk: Trajectory-Conditioned Action Generation for Multi-Turn Agent Safety
items.summary: Tool-using LLM agents extend security risks beyond generated text to actions that affect external systems. Under multi-turn decomposition attacks, a harmful objective can be distributed across individually plausible requests and tool calls, becoming apparent only from the accumulated trajectory. Existing defenses either rely on auxiliary online reasoning to recover long-horizon security evidence or assess actions after generation, often incurring additional inference cost or depending on runtime-specific action representations. We propose \emph{Reassembling Distributed Risk} (ReDiR), a generation-time defense that conditions action generation on trajectory-level security evidence. Before each action, ReDiR compresses the current trajectory into a compact latent safety representation and injects it into the frozen base model. The representation is learned through same-model, cross-view supervision, where safe behavior from an explicit task view provides supervision for recovering distributed safety evidence from the original multi-turn trajectory. This design enables ReDiR to integrate cross-turn security information directly within the generation process without relying on a separate action-level safety module. We evaluate ReDiR on two agent-safety benchmarks across three model families and eight held-out tool domains. ReDiR reduces attack success rates to below 8\%, transfers to unseen tool domains, and preserves benign fidelity with low computational overhead.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出名为 ReDiR (Reassembling Distributed Risk) 的生成时防御方法，针对工具型 LLM 智能体在多轮对话分解攻击下面临的安全风险。这类攻击将有害目标拆解为多个看似合理的请求和工具调用，只有在完整轨迹中累积显现。现有防御要么依赖附加在线推理恢复长程安全证据，要么在生成后评估动作，带来额外推理成本或依赖运行时特定的动作表示。ReDiR 在生成每个动作前，将当前轨迹压缩为紧凑的潜在安全表示并注入冻结的基础模型，通过同模型跨视图监督学习该表示，使得生成过程本身即整合跨轮安全信息，无需独立动作级安全模块。论文在两个智能体安全基准、三个模型族、八个保留工具域上评估，将攻击成功率降至 8% 以下，且能迁移到未见工具域，对良性任务保真度影响小、计算开销低。主要贡献：方法创新（基于轨迹级安全证据的条件动作生成）、消除额外推理成本、跨域迁移能力。适合 LLM 安全、AI agent 防护、红蓝队研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为多轮交互型 LLM 智能体提供了一种不依赖外部安全模块、在生成时内化轨迹风险的自防御范式，对 SOC/蓝队评估 agent 类应用供应链风险和设计运行时缓解措施具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于多轮工具调用型 LLM agent 场景（如自动化运维、客服机器人、代码生成代理）的安全防护，可迁移到未知工具域。

items.title: LMSM: LLM Security Framework Inspired by Linux Security Modules
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with layered defenses, yet malicious prompts can still bypass them. Interpretability methods can expose model-internal signals along the generation path that could inform enforcement, but these signals are not security controls by themselves. Deployments that adapt them for safety typically couple each signal to its own calibration, policy logic, and intervention code, so each new artifact creates integration work instead of strengthening a shared defense. We present Language Model Security Modules (LMSM), a security framework that adapts the separation behind Linux Security Modules (LSM) to LLM serving. In LMSM, a selected security backend exposes calibrated evidence, a versioned policy evaluates active rules over trusted per-request context, and a separate gate authorizes buffered output release. This design separates mediation correctness from policy effectiveness, and it allows backend, rule, or schedule changes without rebuilding request handling or enforcement. Our prototype shows the separation working in practice: with Hugging Face Transformers and continuously batched vLLM, the same substrate hosts artifact-backed sparse autoencoder (SAE) and transcoder deployments and task-fitted dense probes, preserves request-specific decisions under scheduler churn, and selectively enforces and composes multiple rules per request. On Qwen3-4B, LMSM-Checkpoint reduces HarmBench attack success rate from 39.20% to 3.32%, with XSTest false refusals rising from 2.40% to 4.40%, while retaining 98.14% of the throughput of a matched serving path that performs no monitoring work at 32 active sequences. LMSM gives advances in interpretability and model-internal analysis a common path to runtime enforcement.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种面向大语言模型（LLM）的安全框架 LMSM（Language Model Security Modules），其设计灵感来自 Linux 安全模块（LSM）的架构分离思想。当前 LLM 服务通常叠加多层防御，但恶意提示仍可绕过；可解释性方法能够沿生成路径暴露模型内部信号，但这些信号本身并非安全控制，实际部署中若将其用于安全，往往需要为每个信号单独定制校准、策略逻辑和干预代码，导致重复集成工作且难以形成统一防线。LMSM 将安全功能解耦为三个独立组件：安全后端（backend）负责提供经过校准的证据（如稀疏自编码器 SAE、transcoder、密集探针等可解释性产物）、版本化策略模块（policy）根据可信的每请求上下文评估活动规则、以及独立的门控模块（gate）授权缓冲输出的释放。这种设计将中介正确性与策略有效性分离，允许后端、规则或调度策略独立更新，而无需重建请求处理或执行逻辑。原型系统基于 Hugging Face Transformers 和连续批处理推理引擎 vLLM 构建，在 Qwen3-4B 模型上验证了有效性：LMSM-Checkpoint 将 HarmBench 攻击成功率从 39.20% 降至 3.32%，而 XSTest 误拒绝率仅从 2.40% 升至 4.40%，同时在 32 个并发序列下保留了匹配基准路径 98.14% 的吞吐量（该基准不执行监控）。此外，原型展示了在调度器波动下仍能保持请求级决策的一致性，并支持对单个请求选择性执行和组合多条规则。该框架为可解释性和模型内部分析方法提供了通向运行时强制执行的通用途径，是 LLM 安全架构研究的重要进展。适合 LLM 安全研究人员、AI 红蓝队成员以及负责大模型服务加固的工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架将 Linux 安全模块的成熟设计移植到 LLM 服务，有望统一分散的可解释性防御，降低安全策略集成成本，并为模型内部信号提供标准化的强制路径。

items.title: MMJailBench: A Factorized Benchmark for Disentangling Multimodal Jailbreak Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, yet how different factors shape their jailbreak vulnerabilities remains poorly understood. Existing benchmarks often couple harmful intent, prompt framing, visual semantics, and instruction carrier within individual jailbreak instances, obscuring the specific sources of observed vulnerabilities. To address this limitation, we introduce MMJailBench, a factorized benchmark that systematically varies and combines these factors under controlled configurations, enabling fine-grained comparison and factor-level attribution. Large-scale evaluations across 16 open-weight and proprietary MLLMs reveal highly heterogeneous and model-dependent vulnerability profiles. Jailbreak vulnerability varies markedly across harm domains, exposing uneven coverage in current multimodal safety alignment. Prompt framing emerges as the dominant source of variation, task-relevant visual semantics systematically increase jailbreak susceptibility with authority-like cues exposing particularly pronounced vulnerabilities, and visually rendered instructions do not consistently increase jailbreak susceptibility relative to direct textual instructions. To further investigate the risks introduced by multimodal context, we conduct diagnostic analyses on a representative open-weight model and identify vulnerability-associated patterns in internal representations and cross-modal interactions. Finally, we develop a modular multimodal jailbreak evaluation suite with full and lightweight configurations, multiple judge options, and multidimensional metrics, enabling reproducible, scalable, and cost-efficient multimodal jailbreak auditing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在真实世界部署中的越狱（jailbreak）漏洞问题。现有基准测试往往将恶意意图、提示框架、视觉语义和指令载体等多个因素混杂在单个越狱实例中，导致难以定位漏洞的具体来源。为此，作者提出了 MMJailBench，一个因子化基准测试，通过系统化地变化和组合这些因素，实现细粒度比较和因子级归因。研究团队在 16 个开源和专有 MLLM 上进行了大规模评估，发现漏洞画像具有高度异质性和模型依赖性：不同危害领域的越狱漏洞差异显著，暴露出当前多模态安全对齐覆盖不均；提示框架是漏洞变异的主要来源，与任务相关的视觉语义会系统性增加越狱成功率，权威性提示（authority-like cues）尤其明显；而视觉渲染指令相比直接文本指令并未一致性地提高越狱成功率。进一步，作者对一个代表性开源模型进行诊断分析，识别出内部表征和跨模态交互中的漏洞相关模式。最后，他们开发了一个模块化多模态越狱评估工具包，支持完整和轻量级配置、多种评判器选项和多维指标，以实现可复现、可扩展且成本高效的多模态越狱审计。该研究为理解 MLLM 越狱漏洞的构成因素提供了系统方法，适合AI安全研究员、模型开发者和红队评估人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次对多模态越狱漏洞进行因子级归因，揭示提示框架与视觉语义的真实影响，帮助安全团队精准定位对齐盲区，改进多模态安全测试方法。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 为多模态模型安全评估提供标准化基准和工具包，可迁移到模型发布前的安全审计、红队演练及安全对齐优化场景。

items.title: FuzzingBrain-Bench V1: Evaluating Open-Ended Bug Discovery by LLMs
items.summary: Evaluating the ability of large language models (LLMs) to discover software bugs is increasingly important. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate this capability by asking the model to generate a proof-of-concept input that triggers a predefined target vulnerability. However, this setup may overlook valid crashes discovered by the model when they do not match the predefined target. As a result, the evaluation may not reflect the model's real capability. We present FuzzingBrain-Bench, a benchmark for assessing AI models' ability to discover bugs in open-source software. Models are given an open-source project and a sanitizer-instrumented harness in a self-contained Docker image. Their goal is to generate inputs that trigger as many distinct crashes as possible through the harness. A model's performance on each challenge is scored based on the number of distinct crash signatures it produces, capped at a predefined maximum and weighted by a difficulty coefficient. FuzzingBrain-Bench V1 consists of 77 challenges drawn from 43 open-source projects, with 36 C, 32 C++, and 9 Java/JVM challenges. We evaluate Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Opus 4.8 on the full benchmark. Claude Opus 4.8 performs best, triggering crashes in 60 of 77 challenges and achieving a score of 196 out of 579. None of the three models triggers a crash in 13 challenges. The FuzzingBrain-Bench corpus and harnesses are publicly available at https://github.com/fuzzingbrain/FuzzingBrain-Bench.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出并构建了 FuzzingBrain-Bench V1，一个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在开源软件中发现缺陷能力的基准测试。现有评估通常要求模型生成触发预定义目标的 PoC 输入，这忽略了模型发现的、但不匹配预定义目标的合法崩溃，导致评估结果不能真实反映模型能力。FuzzingBrain-Bench 改变了评估范式：将开源项目及其带 sanitizer 的 harness 封装在自包含的 Docker 镜像中，要求模型生成尽可能多的、能引发不同崩溃的输入。得分基于模型产生的不同崩溃签名数量，并设有上限和难度系数加权。V1 包含 43 个开源项目的 77 个挑战，涵盖 36 个 C、32 个 C++ 和 9 个 Java/JVM 项目。作者在完整基准上评估了 Claude Haiku 4.5、Claude Sonnet 4.6 和 Claude Opus 4.8。结果显示 Claude Opus 4.8 表现最佳，在 77 个挑战中的 60 个中触发了崩溃，总分 579 分中得 196 分；三个模型均未能触发 13 个挑战中的任何崩溃。该基准和 harness 已开源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为 LLM 驱动漏洞发现提供更真实的评估标准，改进传统单一目标评估的局限性，对自动化安全测试研究具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响 LLM 辅助 fuzzing 和漏洞挖掘的评估方法，可迁移到其他 AI 代码分析基准设计，有助于安全团队评估 LLM 工具的实用能力。

items.title: Prompt Structure Redistributes, Not Reduces: An Empirical Analysis of Security-Weaknesses in LLM-Generated Python Code
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly generate code from natural-language prompts, making prompt engineering a key mechanism for shaping the security of generated software. Structured and security-oriented prompts are widely used to encourage safer code, yet their effects extend beyond whether detected weaknesses are simply present or absent. Using 424 security-sensitive Python tasks, we generate solutions with GPT-4o and LLaMA 3.1-8B under five prompt variants that progressively add structural and security guidance, and evaluate them with Bandit and CodeQL along two axes: generation compliance and security weakness prevalence, severity, and CWE distributions. Structured prompting substantially reduces refusals (e.g., GPT-4o invalid outputs drop from 338 of 424 to 37-52), enabling large-scale analysis, but security-oriented refinements do not consistently reduce overall weakness prevalence. For GPT-4o, stronger prompts primarily redistribute risk: high-severity findings fall (20.8% to 13.6%) while low-severity findings rise (32% to 43.5%); LLaMA shows weaker, less consistent shifts. We also observe security-driven semantic drift, where stricter prompts silently remove or rewrite explicitly requested unsafe constructs. Overall, prompt structure improves compliance but is an unreliable substitute for robust security controls in LLM-assisted development.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究提示词结构对大型语言模型（LLM）生成代码安全性的影响，而非单纯关注漏洞存在与否。作者使用 424 个安全敏感的 Python 编程任务，在五种逐步增加结构和安全指导的提示词变体下，分别用 GPT-4o 和 LLaMA 3.1-8B 生成代码，并利用 Bandit 和 CodeQL 从生成合规性、安全弱点普遍性、严重性和 CWE 分布两个维度进行评估。实验发现，结构化提示能显著减少模型拒绝生成的情况（例如 GPT-4o 的无效输出从 424 中的 338 降至 37-52），从而支持大规模分析，但安全导向的提示优化并不能持续降低整体弱点出现率。对于 GPT-4o，更强的提示主要使风险重新分布：高危发现从 20.8% 降至 13.6%，而低危发现从 32% 升至 43.5%；LLaMA 则表现出较弱且不一致的变化。此外，研究观察到安全驱动的语义漂移现象，即更严格的提示会悄悄移除或重写用户明确要求的非安全构造。总体而言，提示结构提高了合规性，但在 LLM 辅助开发中不能替代稳健的安全控制。该研究对依赖提示工程来提升代码安全性的实践提出了重要警示，适合软件工程、AI 安全和开发安全团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提示工程常被视为提升 LLM 生成代码安全性的廉价手段，但本研究证明它只是重新分配风险而非降低风险，提醒安全从业者不能过度依赖提示词，而应配合其他安全控制措施。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用 LLM 辅助开发并依赖提示词来确保代码安全的组织和工具链；尤其对 AI 代码生成平台的安全评估和 CWE 分布理解有参考价值。
detection_signals_zh: 在 LLM 生成的代码中同时关注高危和低危漏洞分布，避免仅统计总数
监控因提示词强化而导致代码语义发生非预期变化的情况（语义漂移）
defense_advice_zh: 不要将提示词作为唯一安全防线，应结合静态分析、人工审查和运行时防护

items.title: Do System Prompts Leave Behavioral Fingerprints? A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Clone Detection via Output Similarity
items.summary: System prompts can be extracted from commercial LLMs with over 80\% success and redeployed at zero cost, yet a prompt owner has no way to verify whether a suspected deployment is a clone. We propose Black-Box Behavioral Fingerprinting (BBF): the prompt owner registers a behavioral signature from model outputs and later tests whether a suspect deployment matches that signature more closely than an unrelated baseline. BBF requires only black-box API access. Through a large-scale study (4 model families, 8 benchmarks, 288{,}000 responses), we find that prompt choice explains 24.4\% of output variance and same-model detection reaches AUC 0.876. Cross-model performance is bounded by detector identity, with off-diagonal AUC ranging from 0.845 (Claude as detector) down to 0.665 (Qwen) and overall mean 0.725. BBF resists non-adaptive prompt paraphrasing (AUC $\geq 0.889$) and is robust to imperfect extraction, but a single-sentence formal-tone prefix can collapse detection on short structured outputs (MNLI 0.978 $\to$ 0.547), isolating style-invariant detection as the key open problem. Diagnostic Query Optimization, a zero-cost query selection rule, adds $+0.120$ to cross-model AUC.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了一个现实且严峻的安全问题：商业LLM的系统提示（system prompt）可以被攻击者以超过80%的成功率提取，并以零成本重新部署，但提示所有者无法验证某个可疑部署是否为克隆。为此，作者提出了黑盒行为指纹识别（Black-Box Behavioral Fingerprinting, BBF）方法。BBF的核心思路是：提示所有者先从自身模型的输出中注册一个行为签名，随后通过黑盒API访问测试可疑部署，判断其输出是否与该签名匹配度显著高于无关基线。该方法仅需要黑盒访问，不依赖模型内部参数。作者进行了大规模实证研究，覆盖4个模型家族、8个基准测试、共288,000条响应。实验发现：提示选择解释了24.4%的输出方差；在同模型检测（即提示所有者与被测模型相同）场景下，AUC达到0.876。跨模型检测性能受检测器身份影响，非对角线AUC从Claude作为检测器时的0.845到Qwen的0.665不等，总体均值为0.725。BBF对非适应性提示改写具有鲁棒性（AUC不低于0.889），并且对不完美的提示提取也有抵抗力。然而，一个单句的正式语气前缀就可使基于短结构化输出的检测能力崩溃（MNLI任务AUC从0.978降至0.547），这凸显出风格不变性检测是未来需要解决的关键开放问题。此外，作者提出了一种零成本的查询选择规则——诊断查询优化（Diagnostic Query Optimization），可将跨模型AUC提升+0.120。该研究为系统提示的归属认证与克隆检测提供了新的技术路线，对LLM知识产权保护和供应链安全具有重要意义。适合关注LLM安全、模型指纹识别、知识产权保护的研究者和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 系统提示是商业LLM的核心资产，提取与克隆攻击严重威胁模型知识产权。该研究首次系统性地提出并验证黑盒行为指纹识别方法，为提示所有者提供可行的克隆检测手段，是LLM安全防御的重要补充。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于商业LLM服务提供商的提示版权保护、模型部署的合规审计，以及API接入方的安全风控场景；也可迁移到其他生成式模型的指纹识别任务。
detection_signals_zh: 可疑部署的输出行为与原始提示所有者的输出分布显著相似（如AUC超过阈值）
在精心设计的诊断查询上，可疑模型与原始模型的输出一致性异常偏高
defense_advice_zh: 对系统提示进行混淆或分段管理，增加提取难度
在公开API中引入输出扰动或水印，干扰行为指纹的匹配
定期使用BBF黑盒检测可疑部署，并及时维权

items.title: Towards LLM-Enhanced Android Taint Analysis
items.summary: Taint analysis is a fundamental technique for detecting sensitive data leaks in Android apps. However, traditional static tools, such as FlowDroid, still face well-known challenges due to the complexity of accurately modeling the Android framework. In this paper, we investigate whether off-the-shelf Large Language Models (LLMs) can effectively reason about taint flows in Android apps. Our preliminary approach relies on an agentic interaction strategy, enabling the LLM to iteratively explore code and reason about data flows. We conduct an initial evaluation on the DroidBench benchmark against FlowDroid, where our approach outperforms the baseline: Gemini-3 Flash achieves an F1-score of 0.96, compared to 0.55 for FlowDroid. In particular, we observe improvements in challenging categories such as inter-component communication (0.95 vs. 0.17), implicit flows (0.94 vs. 0.00), and reflection (1.00 vs. 0.50), where FlowDroid typically struggles. On a small set of real-world apps, the LLM-based approach also identifies additional potential data leaks not reported by FlowDroid. These preliminary findings suggest that LLM reasoning may effectively complement traditional static taint analysis, motivating future research on hybrid LLM-enhanced taint analysis pipelines.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文旨在探索现成的大型语言模型（LLM）能否有效推理安卓应用中的污点流，以解决传统静态分析工具在准确建模 Android 框架方面长期存在的挑战。作者提出了一种基于代理交互（agentic interaction）的初步方法：LLM 通过迭代的方式检查代码片段、推理数据从源（source）到汇聚点（sink）的传播路径，并做出是否存在敏感数据泄露的判断。在 DroidBench 基准上，作者使用 Gemini-3 Flash 进行了初步评估，并与业界标准工具 FlowDroid 比较。结果显示，该方法的 F1 分数达到 0.96，远高于 FlowDroid 的 0.55。尤其在具有挑战性的类别中表现突出：组件间通信（ICC）的 F1 为 0.95 vs FlowDroid 的 0.17，隐式流为 0.94 vs 0.00，反射为 1.00 vs 0.50。此外，在少量真实世界的安卓应用上，LLM 方法报告了 FlowDroid 未发现的额外潜在数据泄漏。这些初步证据表明，LLM 的语义理解能力能够补充传统静态污点分析的不足，并启发未来构建混合式 LLM 增强污点分析管道的研究方向。该工作对恶意应用分析、隐私合规检测等场景具有潜在价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了 LLM 在安卓隐私泄漏检测上的巨大潜力，尤其是传统工具无能为力的隐式流和反射场景。它预示着未来的恶意应用分析与隐私审计可能采用 LLM 辅助的混合方案，值得安全团队关注评估。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面集中于安卓静态分析工具链、移动应用安全审计和隐私合规检测。该方法可迁移到其他平台或语言的污点分析，以及组件间通信相关的漏洞检测场景。

items.title: Poisoning Agentic Alpha: Adversarial Vulnerabilities Across Roles and Architectures in Multi-Agent Trading Systems
items.summary: LLM-based multi-agent trading systems, in which specialized agents collaborate through structured communication to produce trading decisions, are moving rapidly from research prototypes to live deployments that control real assets. The same inter-agent communication that makes them effective also exposes them: a corrupted signal can propagate to the final decision and translate into realized financial loss. Unlike prior attacks that presume privileged access to system internals, we restrict the adversary to what is practically reachable---the source data and prompts agents consume---yielding a low-barrier, and thus democratized threat model instantiated as role-specific adversaries. We present the first systematic empirical study in the financial domain to characterize how an adversarial signal enters a multi-agent trading system and how far it survives toward the decision. Along the role axis, we decompose a widely-used trading pipeline into four functional roles---Analyst, Researcher, Trader, and Risk Manager---and pair each with an attack matched to its interface. Along the structural axis, we evaluate four communication topologies under data- and agent-level attacks, using the Adversarial Signal Preservation Score (APS) as a post-hoc lens on why some designs are more robust than others. We conduct experiments across five assets, two backbones, and two target directions. A central finding is that no architecture is inherently robust. These findings provide insights for the future design of safer and more robust agentic trading systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统研究了基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体交易系统中的对抗性漏洞。这类系统由多个专业智能体通过结构化通信协作生成交易决策，正从研究原型快速走向控制真实资产的实时部署。然而，智能体间的通信在提升效率的同时也引入了攻击面：一个被污染的信号可能传播至最终决策，造成实际财务损失。与以往假设攻击者具有系统内部特权访问的攻击不同，本文将攻击者的能力限制在实际可触及的范围——即智能体消费的源数据和提示词——从而构建了一个低门槛、去中心化的威胁模型，具体实例化为不同角色的攻击者。论文首次在金融领域开展了系统性实证研究，刻画对抗性信号如何进入多智能体交易系统以及能在多大程度上影响最终决策。在角色维度上，作者将常用交易流水线分解为四个功能角色：分析师、研究员、交易员和风险经理，并为每个角色匹配合适的攻击方式。在结构维度上，评估了四种通信拓扑在数据级和智能体级攻击下的表现，并提出对抗信号保留分数（Adversarial Signal Preservation Score, APS）作为事后分析工具，用于解释为何某些设计比其他设计更具鲁棒性。实验覆盖五种资产、两个主干模型和两个目标方向。核心发现是：没有任何架构天然免疫。这些结果为设计更安全、更鲁棒的多智能体交易系统提供了洞见。适合人工智能安全、金融科技、多智能体系统等领域的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多智能体交易系统已开始落地，其通信链路可能成为新型攻击面。本文首次系统揭示这类系统的对抗性脆弱性，对蓝队评估AI系统安全、设计鲁棒架构具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于LLM的多智能体交易系统及其部署场景，包括涉及真实资金的自动交易平台。研究结论可迁移至其他多智能体协作系统（如智能客服、自动化运维）的安全评估。

items.title: Crossplane's TOCTOU between cosign verification and image fetch in xpkg.CachedClient allows tag-based package install to bypass signature check
items.summary:
## Summary

Crossplane allows package signature verification to be configured via the `ImageConfig` mechanism. When enabled, the package manager uses cosign to verify that packages are correctly signed before pulling and installing them.

When a package is installed using a tag reference (e.g., a semantic version), a malicious OCI registry could serve a correctly signed image for verification, then subsequently serve an unsigned image for installation. This is possible because Crossplane resolves the tag reference separately for each step.

This vulnerability is relevant only for users who do all three of the following:

1. Configure signature verification for packages,
2. Install packages using tag references rather than digests, and
3. Install packages from registries they do not control.

## Mitigation

Installing packages by image digest rather than using tags avoids this issue.

## Fix

The package manager has been updated to resolve tag references once and use the resulting digest for both signature verification and image fetching. This ensures that Crossplane pulls the same content that had its signature verified. The fix has been applied to Crossplane's `main` branch and backported to the v2.3 and v2.2 release branches; it will be released in v2.3.3 and v2.2.3.

## Credits

This issue was reported, independently, by @bugbunny-research and @tonghuaroot.

items.title: Evaluating and Preventing Security Smells in AI-Generated Ansible Code
items.summary: AI coding assistants generate Infrastructure as Code, yet no work has examined whether this code meets security requirements. This matters because security smells in infrastructure code propagate to deployed systems, producing infrastructure that is insecure and untrustworthy. We evaluate 16 AI models generating Ansible roles for Apache Tomcat v10 and MongoDB v7, analysing 278 Ansible roles against CIS benchmarks. Without security guidance, all 16 AI models produced code containing security smells, resulting in vulnerable infrastructure that fails compliance verification and underperforms code written by human developers. We introduce an approach integrating Ansible best practices and CIS benchmarks into prompts through an extended CO-STAR framework, enabling security smell prevention during synthesis rather than detection after deployment. When this approach is applied, 4 out of 16 models generate compliant code, with the leading model achieving 95%-100% CIS compliance, a fourfold improvement over humans at 23%-43%, with overall code quality improving by 19%-49%. The remaining 12 models fail not because they cannot generate code but because they cannot follow instructions with multiple constraints. For capable models, the approach requires no retraining and can be adopted through system prompts.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了AI编程助手生成的基础设施即代码（IaC）中存在的安全问题。以往研究大多关注AI生成代码的功能正确性，但对其安全性关注不足。作者指出，如果基础设施代码存在安全缺陷，会直接传播到部署的系统，导致不可信的基础设施。论文评估了16个AI模型生成Ansible角色（用于Apache Tomcat v10和MongoDB v7）的情况，共分析278个角色，并与CIS基准进行了比对。结果发现，在没有安全指导的情况下，所有16个模型生成的代码都存在安全味道（security smells），导致基础设施易受攻击、无法通过合规验证，且整体性能不如人类开发者编写的代码。为此，作者提出了一种新方法：通过扩展CO-STAR框架，将Ansible最佳实践和CIS基准整合到提示词中，使AI在代码生成阶段就能预防安全味道，而非在部署后再检测。应用该方法后，16个模型中有4个能够生成合规代码，其中表现最好的模型达到了95%-100%的CIS合规率，相比人类开发者的23%-43%提升了四倍，同时整体代码质量提升了19%-49%。其余12个模型失败的原因并非无法生成代码，而是无法遵循包含多重约束的指令。对于能力足够的模型，该方法无需重新训练，只需通过系统提示词即可采用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: AI生成IaC日益常见，但安全合规性常被忽视。该研究量化了风险并提出提示词层面的预防方案，对依赖AI辅助编码的蓝队/SOC团队有直接参考价值，可避免将不安全基础设施引入生产环境。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用AI助手生成Ansible等IaC的团队，特别是涉及Tomcat/MongoDB等常见组件时。方法可迁移至其他IaC工具（如Terraform、CloudFormation）及其他安全基准。
detection_signals_zh: AI生成的Ansible代码中出现重复使用sudo等危险权限或缺乏文件权限配置
生成的配置中未定义失败策略或未限制错误处理方式
使用硬编码密钥或未经加密的变量信息
配置边界未按照CIS基准进行设置（如Tomcat的server.xml或MongoDB的配置文件）
defense_advice_zh: 在AI编码助手的系统提示词中集成CIS基准和Ansible最佳实践
对AI生成的IaC进行自动化静态扫描，并与CIS基准对齐
建立人工审查机制，特别是对安全相关配置进行双重验证
优先选择在提示词引导下能遵循多重约束的模型
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: From Verdict to Diagnosis: Attributable Security Review of Pull Requests
items.summary: Automated code reviewers are increasingly used as gates on pull requests (PRs), yet evaluations measure whether they block a malicious change. A block may be triggered by an unrelated issue rather than the vulnerability that makes the PR unsafe; fixing the reported issue can leave the target defect exploitable. We call this discrepancy the Verdict-Diagnosis (VD) gap. We present MalPR-Bench, a mechanism-grounded benchmark of 89 malicious PRs and 50 paired benign controls across 44 repositories and eight language families. Each malicious case has a pre-committed rubric specifying the target vulnerability, accepted mechanism descriptions, required repository evidence, and off-target findings receiving no credit. Reviews are scored separately for verdict correctness, target-vulnerability identification, and evidence validation; an attributable block requires all three. We introduce PRGuard, an attributable PR security reviewer that constructs candidate vulnerabilities and validates their premises against repository evidence using deterministic, non-executing tools and bounded retrieval. Across 31 common-coverage held-out malicious PRs, PRGuard and CodeRabbit produce similar blocking totals (22/31 vs. 24/31), but PRGuard identifies 22 target vulnerabilities versus 16 for CodeRabbit, a 1.38x difference. On 14 absence-type cases, both block 9, while PRGuard identifies 9 targets versus 3. CodeRabbit identifies 16/24 targets when required evidence lies within touched files and 0/7 when validation requires evidence outside them. Finally, PRGuard uncovers twelve previously undisclosed, proof-of-concept-backed vulnerabilities across five projects. PRGuard/DeepSeek and CodeRabbit both block 10/12 discovery PRs, but produce 10/12 and 4/12 attributable blocks, respectively. Thus, verdict-only evaluation can substantially overstate the security value of automated review.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文聚焦自动化代码审查在拉取请求（PR）安全门禁中的评估缺陷。现有评估指标通常只关注是否阻止了恶意变更，但阻止可能由无关问题触发，而非真正导致PR不安全的漏洞；修复所报告的问题后，目标漏洞仍可能被利用。作者将此称为“裁决-诊断差距”（Verdict-Diagnosis Gap）。为解决此问题，他们提出了MalPR-Bench，一个基于机制标注的基准，包含44个仓库、8种语言家族中的89个恶意PR和50个配对良性对照。每个恶意案例都预先提交了评估标准，明确目标漏洞、接受的机制描述、所需仓库证据以及不计分的非目标发现。评分分别针对裁决正确性、目标漏洞识别和证据验证进行；只有三者同时满足才算“可归因阻止”。他们进一步提出PRGuard，一个可归因的PR安全审查器，它利用确定性、非执行的工具和有界检索，构造候选漏洞并验证其前提与仓库证据的一致性。在31个常见覆盖的保留恶意PR上，PRGuard与CodeRabbit的阻止总数相近（22/31 vs 24/31），但PRGuard识别出22个目标漏洞，而CodeRabbit仅识别出16个，差距为1.38倍。在14个缺失类型案例中，两者都阻止了9个，但PRGuard识别出9个目标，而CodeRabbit仅识别出3个。当所需证据位于接触文件中时，CodeRabbit能识别16/24个目标；当验证需要外部证据时，只能识别0/7个。最后，PRGuard在五个项目中发现了十二个此前未公开、基于概念验证支持的漏洞。在发现PR上，PRGuard/DeepSeek和CodeRabbit都阻止了10/12个，但可归因阻止分别是10/12和4/12。研究结论是：仅依赖裁决结果的评估可能显著高估自动化审查的安全价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了当前AI代码审查评估方式的根本缺陷，为蓝队选择和使用自动化PR审查工具提供了量化依据，帮助避免被“阻止率”误导，从而更准确地评估漏洞发现能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖自动化代码审查作为安全门禁的DevSecOps流程；方法论可迁移至其他安全任务评估（如漏洞扫描、恶意代码检测）。

items.title: ADeptS-Bench: Measuring the Trustworthiness of Computer Use Agents Across Devices
items.summary: Computer Use Agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed to navigate mobile and desktop applications on behalf of users, yet no benchmark comprehensively evaluates whether they can safely interact with visual interfaces while handling ambiguous instructions. We introduce ADeptS-Bench, a dual-stream trustworthiness benchmark, grounded in the ADEPTS capability framework and general population user studies. The Safety stream provides paired benign/malicious tasks with threats embedded in the visual interface. The Disambiguation stream evaluates whether agents seek clarification when intent is ambiguous. Evaluating seven models reveals that no model consistently exceeds 80% task success while staying below 30% attack success; every model clicks "Checkout" on a $25K order without hesitation, and none detects that a "factory reset" button is mislabeled as "Optimize." An ablation reveals three distinct safety architectures: tool-dependent (ASR +21-23pp without refusal tool), partially tool-dependent (+10-11pp), and no mechanism (unchanged). In disambiguation, all models overestimate consequence severity, mirroring the over-refusal bias observed in safety. We release all data, evaluation code, and analysis tools upon publication.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对计算机使用智能体（Computer Use Agents, CUAs）在跨设备（移动端与桌面端）视觉界面中的可信赖性评估缺失问题，提出了ADeptS-Bench基准测试。研究背景是：随着CUAs被广泛部署以代表用户操作应用程序，它们需要同时应对视觉界面中的安全威胁和模糊指令中的潜在风险，但现有基准未能全面覆盖这两方面。核心方法包括：构建双流（dual-stream）可信赖性基准，基于ADEPTS能力框架和一般人群用户研究设计任务。Safety流提供成对的良性/恶意任务，将威胁嵌入视觉界面；Disambiguation流评估智能体在意图模糊时是否主动寻求澄清。实验评估了七个模型，结果显示没有任何模型能在任务成功率超过80%的同时将攻击成功率控制在30%以下；所有模型都会毫不犹豫地点击2.5万美元订单的“结账”按钮，且均未检测到“恢复出厂设置”按钮被错误标注为“优化”。通过消融实验，识别出三种安全架构：工具依赖型（移除拒绝工具后攻击成功率增加21-23个百分点）、部分工具依赖型（增加10-11个百分点）以及无安全机制型（攻击成功率不变）。在消融实验中，所有模型都高估了后果严重性，反映出与安全领域中过度拒绝偏误相似的现象。作者承诺在论文发表后公开所有数据、评估代码和分析工具。本研究的主要贡献是为CUA可信赖性提供了首个双流评估基准，揭示了当前模型在关键安全场景中的缺陷，并为未来安全架构设计提供了方向。适合AI安全研究员、智能体系统开发者、人机交互与安全交叉领域从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准首次系统评估了计算机使用智能体在视觉界面上的安全性，揭示主流模型存在严重安全缺陷，对AI agent的部署和监管具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于视觉界面的自主智能体（如移动端助手、桌面自动化工具），以及依赖此类智能体的电商、系统维护等场景；有助于改进智能体安全对齐方法。
detection_signals_zh: 智能体在高价值操作（如大额支付）前未进行二次确认
对视觉元素标签（如按钮文本）的错误理解导致危险操作
在指令意图模糊时直接执行而非请求澄清
defense_advice_zh: 在智能体流程中强制加入关键操作的风险确认机制
对视觉界面元素进行语义一致性校验，防止误导性标签
训练阶段引入对抗性视觉扰动和模糊指令样本
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Anatomy of a Scam Call: What 10,000 real scam and spam calls reveal about how phone scammers operate
items.summary: Telephone fraud is pervasive and costly, but its inner workings are rarely observed at scale. We analyze a complete corpus of 10,211 inbound scam and spam calls -- 913 hours of audio and 330,956 transcribed turns from 5,780 distinct numbers -- collected over 54 days by an AI voice-agent honeypot that answered callers and kept them talking, and introduced in a companion data descriptor. We separate outright scams, which solicit sensitive information, from the larger stream of predatory but legal lead generation ("spam") that feeds them. Scam operations keep office hours (6.6x more calls per weekday than weekend day); thousands of disposable numbers run a small catalog of recycled scripts (thirty opening clusters, half the traffic in the top five); and callers solicit identity anchors -- a home address and a date of birth -- far more often than payment credentials, pressing through persistence and manufactured authority rather than overt threats. Our central experiment asks: does it matter who picks up? Every seeded lead carried one of ten fictitious identities drawn uniformly at random, so the identity a fraud operation reaches is fixed before the caller exists. Across 1,823 randomized calls, scammers spent about 15% more conversational turns per decade of the target's apparent age (rate ratio 1.15, 95% CI 1.08-1.23; randomization p = 0.005) -- yet what they asked for did not change (26.3% of calls reached a request for sensitive information; odds ratio 0.99 per decade, 95% CI 0.90-1.08). A second experiment casts early detection as a benchmark: from a scammer's opening lines alone, on a caller-disjoint split, escalation is predictable at 0.72 ROC-AUC from the first line and 0.87 by the eighth, and a plain bag-of-words classifier matches a fine-tuned on-device language model. Telephone fraud emerges as a templated industry that varies how hard it works a target, but not what it wants.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文基于一个由AI语音代理蜜罐系统收集的独特数据集，对电话诈骗和垃圾电话的运作模式进行了大规模实证分析。数据集包含54天内来自5,780个不同号码的10,211通入站电话，共计913小时音频和330,956轮对话转录。研究首先区分了真正骗取敏感信息的诈骗电话与虽然具有掠夺性但合法的线索生成（垃圾）电话，发现诈骗运营遵循工作时间规律（工作日的电话量是周末的6.6倍），大量一次性号码使用少量循环脚本（30个开场聚类，前五个占据一半流量）。诈骗者更常索要身份锚点（家庭住址和出生日期），而非支付凭证，通过坚持和制造权威而非直接威胁来施压。核心实验围绕“接听者身份是否重要”展开：每条线索随机分配十个虚构身份之一，在1,823通随机电话中，目标表观年龄每增加十年，诈骗者多花费约15%的对话轮次（比率1.15，95% CI 1.08-1.23，p=0.005），但索要的内容没有显著变化（26.3%的电话达到索要敏感信息阶段，每十年优势比0.99）。第二个实验将早期检测作为基准任务：仅凭诈骗者的开场白，在呼叫者不相交的划分上，从第一行预测升级的ROC-AUC为0.72，到第八行达到0.87，且简单的词袋分类器与微调的端侧语言模型表现相当。研究结论认为电话诈骗是一个模板化行业，其工作强度因目标而异，但索要的内容不变。该研究适用于理解电话诈骗的社会工程策略、开发自动检测系统以及相关反欺诈政策制定，主要面向语言处理、网络安全和计算社会科学领域的研究者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次以大规模真实通话数据揭示电话诈骗的模板化运作模式，证明诈骗者行为可预测，为构建语音层面的诈骗早期检测系统提供了数据支撑和基线方法。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响电话诈骗检测系统的设计，可迁移到语音助手、实时通话监控、反欺诈风控等场景；其公开数据集可复用于社会工程学分析和AI安全研究。

items.title: Thresholding Post-Quantum Signatures
items.summary: Threshold signature schemes distribute the signing process among $T$ parties out of $N$. They enable a variety of applications and their research is also motivated by a recent NIST call. However, applications are dominated by pre-quantum signatures, which are more efficient but not secure in the post-quantum setting. This paper investigates existing post-quantum signatures, based on a variety of paradigms: lattice problems, one-way (hash) functions, cryptographic group actions, isogenies and multivariate systems. We propose a classification (divided by paradigm) of existing tools that are used to build $T$-out-of-$N$ schemes from digital signatures. We also include general approaches based on FHE, MPC or ZKP.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文针对后量子签名方案的阈值化问题展开系统性研究。阈值签名方案允许在 N 个参与方中任意 T 个协作生成有效签名，广泛应用于分布式系统、区块链和密钥管理，但现有主流方案仍依赖 RSA、ECDSA 等预量子签名，难以抵御未来量子计算机的攻击。NIST 已呼吁标准化后量子阈值密码学，因此探索与后量子签名兼容的阈值化方法成为当前重要课题。论文首先梳理了基于格、单向哈希函数、密码群作用、同源和多变量系统等不同密码学范式的后量子签名方案，并针对每种范式总结了当前用于构建 T-out-of-N 阈值签名的主要技术与工具，从而提出了一种按范式划分的系统分类。此外，作者还讨论了基于全同态加密（FHE）、安全多方计算（MPC）和零知识证明（ZKP）的通用阈值化方法，这些方法不局限于特定签名结构。论文的主要贡献包括：(1) 提供了后量子签名阈值化的全面分类框架，方便研究者快速定位各类方案的技术路线；(2) 对比不同范式的特点，指出了各自在效率、密钥大小和安全性假设上的权衡；(3) 为未来 NIST 标准化工作提供参考。该研究适合密码学研究人员、后量子安全评估者以及关注密码迁移的工程技术人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 后量子密码迁移是当前安全基础设施升级的核心议题，阈值签名在区块链、多方计算和密钥管理中扮演关键角色。本文系统分类了后量子阈值签名方案，为安全团队评估和规划迁移路径提供了重要参考，直接影响未来密码系统的抗量子能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该分类视角可应用于后量子密码算法选型、安全评估、标准化跟踪以及阈值协议设计。对依赖阈值签名的行业（如金融、区块链、云计算）而言，理解不同后量子方案的阈值化可行性有助于提前布局。
defense_advice_zh: 建议安全团队关注 NIST 后量子标准化进程，并评估现有系统对后量子阈值签名的兼容性，同时跟踪本文涉及的技术路线以选择适合自身场景的方案。

items.title: SysComb: Fine-Grained Transparent System Call Filtering for Attack Surface Reduction
items.summary: Restricting the system calls available to applications shrinks the kernel's attack surface and greatly mitigates the impact of compromised programs. Recent approaches showcase techniques to generate system call filters, however, all existing solutions require either kernel or application modifications to activate them at runtime. This is intrusive, error-prone, and often impractical, especially when the code is maintained by external parties. This paper presents SysComb, a novel eBPF-based solution to enforce temporally-specialized system call filters based on the application state, without requiring any modification to the application or the kernel code, and thus addressing the above limitations. Moreover, SysComb lets the developer choose between two distinct enforcement strategies: seccomp-like, ensuring no new privileges are gained after a state transition is performed, and least-privilege, which applies to each state the most restrictive filter. We evaluated SysComb using widely used software, showcasing accurate state-aware system call filtering and an overhead comparable to built-in kernel solutions, demonstrating the practicality of our approach.

llm_summary.summary_zh: SysComb 提出了一种基于 eBPF 的系统调用过滤方案，旨在通过限制应用程序可用的系统调用来缩小内核攻击面，从而缓解被攻陷程序带来的影响。现有方案通常需要修改内核或应用程序代码才能在运行时激活过滤器，这具有侵入性、易出错且不切实际，尤其当代码由外部维护时。SysComb 无需修改应用或内核代码即可实现基于应用程序状态的时态特化系统调用过滤，解决了上述限制。它允许开发者选择两种不同的强制策略：第一种是类似 seccomp 的策略，确保状态转换后不获得新权限；第二种是最小权限策略，对每个状态应用最严格的过滤器。作者使用广泛使用的软件进行了评估，展示了准确的状态感知系统调用过滤能力，其开销与内核内置方案相当，证明了该方法的实用性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该系统调用过滤方案无需修改应用或内核即可动态生效，显著降低部署门槛，为 SOC/安全团队提供了一种可落地的攻击面削减手段，尤其适合保护第三方维护的遗留或商业软件。

items.title: Pointing the Way, Hiding the Destination: Practical Private Dense Retrieval at Scale
items.summary: Hosted retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search allow users to query valuable provider-held corpora, raising two competing demands: to hide each query and chosen result, yet reveal only the documents that the user is authorized to receive. Existing cryptographic approaches either make this costly by processing the entire corpus for every query, or sacrifice quality for efficiency by scanning a few clusters. We repurpose learned deep hashing as a private filter: a randomized binary code points the provider to a short candidate list, while encrypted reranking and oblivious key transfer protect the precise query and final selection. This shortlist short-circuits full-corpus cryptographic search without sacrificing retrieval quality: with 200-500 candidates, it closely matches full-corpus retrieval across five zero-shot corpora spanning 25K to 5.4M documents. On the full 2.68M-passage NQ corpus over a 10-Gbps link, our protocol only adds 0.73 seconds, or 10 percent, to a 128-token Qwen3-32B RAG pipeline. The released code satisfies directional metric differential privacy (DP) and substantially reduces embedding-inversion and property-inference leakage, demonstrating that a carefully learned shortlist can make private dense retrieval both accurate and practical.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种实用的私有稠密检索方案，用于托管式检索增强生成（RAG）和语义搜索场景。核心矛盾在于：用户希望隐藏自己的查询和最终选中的文档，而服务提供商希望只向授权用户暴露其有权访问的文档，同时保护语料库的机密性。现有密码学方法要么对每个查询都要处理整个语料库，成本高昂；要么通过扫描少量聚类来牺牲检索质量以换取效率。作者将学习型深度哈希重新设计为一种“私有过滤器”：通过随机化的二进制编码，服务提供商只需根据该编码返回一个较短的候选列表，随后通过加密的重排序和 oblivious key transfer 来保护精确查询和最终选择，避免了对全语料库进行密码学计算。实验表明，在包含 2.5 万到 540 万文档的五个零样本语料库上，仅需 200-500 个候选文档即可逼近全语料库检索的质量。在完整的 268 万段落 NQ 语料库上，基于 10 Gbps 链路，该协议仅为使用 128 token 的 Qwen3-32B RAG 流水线增加了 0.73 秒（约 10%）的延迟。发布的代码满足定向度量差分隐私（DP），并大幅减少了嵌入反演和属性推断泄漏。这项工作证明，精心学习的短列表可以同时实现私有稠密检索的准确性和实用性。适合对隐私保护检索、RAG 安全、密码学与机器学习交叉领域感兴趣的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为托管 RAG 和语义搜索提供了实用的隐私保护方案，能在不显著牺牲性能的情况下隐藏用户查询和结果，对依赖第三方知识库的 AI 应用具有直接参考价值。

items.title: FRESCO: Complete and Scalable Temporal Safety for CHERI Application Processors
items.summary: CHERI provides hardware-enforced spatial memory safety. While prior work extends it with heap temporal safety, stack use-after-return remains unaddressed. Existing defenses fall short: compiler analysis reliably catches only references that escape as function return values, while dynamic sanitizers impose overheads that preclude production deployment. We present FRESCO, built on the principle that a stack capability must not outlive the frame that created it. FRESCO "colors" the stack pointer with per-invocation provenance identifiers; every capability derived from it inherits that lifetime and is hardware-invalidated the moment the function exits, regardless of how or where it escaped. Because stack frames retire orders of magnitude more frequently than heap allocations, FRESCO manages the resulting color pressure through: 1) Color Saver, a static capability-aware escape analysis that confines coloring to functions needing it, and whose core algorithm we mechanically verify in Rocq, and 2) capability-color segmentation, which partitions memory into disjoint segments, each with an independent color namespace. Color segmentation lets stack and heap temporal safety coexist on one system, making FRESCO the first hardware/software co-design to provide complete and scalable temporal safety for CHERI application processors. We realize FRESCO on the CHERI-RISC-V QEMU full-system emulator and the out-of-order CHERI-Toooba FPGA softcore, with software support in the CHERI-enabled Clang/LLVM compiler and CheriBSD OS. FRESCO systematically prevents use-after-return, use-after-free, and double-free across the NIST Juliet Test Suite and CVEs, with only a small run-time overhead in SPEC CPU (4% g.m.), SQLite, and PostgreSQL (10-14%).

llm_summary.summary_zh: CHERI 架构通过硬件增强提供了空间内存安全，但时间内存安全问题（如 use-after-return）仍未解决。现有的编译器分析只能可靠捕获作为函数返回值逃逸的引用，而动态消毒工具的开销过高，难以在生产环境部署。本文提出 FRESCO，一种基于“栈能力不得比创建它的帧更长寿”原则的硬件/软件协同设计。FRESCO 为栈指针引入每次调用的来源标识符进行“着色”，所有从该指针派生的能力都继承此生命周期，并在函数退出时由硬件立即失效，无论能力如何或在哪里逃逸。由于栈帧的回收频率远高于堆分配，FRESCO 通过两项技术管理颜色压力：1）Color Saver，一种静态能力感知逃逸分析，将着色限制在确实需要的函数上，其核心算法在 Rocq 中进行了机械验证；2）能力颜色分段，将内存划分为不相交的段，每段拥有独立的颜色命名空间，从而让栈与堆的时间安全机制能在同一系统上共存。FRESCO 在 CHERI-RISC-V QEMU 全系统模拟器和乱序 CHERI-Toooba FPGA 软核上实现，并集成到 CHERI 版 Clang/LLVM 编译器及 CheriBSD 操作系统中。实验评估表明，FRESCO 能系统性阻止 NIST Juliet 测试套件和相关 CVE 中的 use-after-return、use-after-free 和 double-free 漏洞，同时在 SPEC CPU（4% 几何平均）、SQLite 和 PostgreSQL（10-14%）中仅引入很小的运行时开销。该工作首次为 CHERI 应用处理器提供了完整且可扩展的时间内存安全解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: FRESCO 填补了 CHERI 在栈时间安全上的空白，使硬件内存安全能力更完整。对依赖 CHERI 或类似能力的系统，该方案有望大幅提升对释放后使用类漏洞的防护，值得安全架构师和编译器开发者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响 CHERI 架构及其生态（编译器、操作系统、处理器核），可推广到其他基于能力机的安全设计，尤其适用于对内存安全要求高的场景。

items.title: Beyond F1: Evaluating Coverage and Failure Recovery in AI Model Security Scanners
items.summary: Static scanners are increasingly used to identify executable or otherwise unsafe content in machine- learning artifacts, yet conventional evaluation metrics characterize only cases where a scanner yields a usable security judgment. We evaluate ModelScan, ModelAudit, and Fickling using a controlled, artifact-backed benchmark on a synthetic corpus of 170 Pickle and PyTorch focused artifacts across 145 specimen families, 135 of which have binary security ground truth and 10 of which are intentionally malformed without labels. We explicitly distinguish non-N/A coverage, analysis completion, definitive security decisions, non-security findings, and unsupported outcomes. On labeled families, ModelAudit produced definitive security decisions for all 135 families (100%), Fickling for 110 (81.5%), and ModelScan for 67 (49.6%). Conditional on making a definitive judgment, ModelScan achieved 100% precision, recall, and F1. Fickling identified no unique true- positive families beyond those found by the combination of ModelAudit and ModelScan. Furthermore, for the 48 malicious families where ModelScan failed to complete its analysis, both ModelAudit and Fickling generated detections consistent with ground truth. These findings underscore the need to separate judgment accuracy from judgment availability, as well as incremental detection coverage from tool-level redundancy.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对机器学习工件安全扫描器的评估方法展开研究。传统的安全扫描器评估指标（如 F1）只刻画扫描器能给出可用安全判断的情况，而忽略了扫描器无法给出判断或分析失败的场景。作者提出了一个受控的、基于真实工件的基准测试框架，在包含 170 个 Pickle 和 PyTorch 工件的合成语料库上评估了 ModelScan、ModelAudit 和 Fickling 三款扫描器。该语料库覆盖 145 个标本家族，其中 135 个具有二值化的安全真值标签，10 个被故意构造为畸形样本且无标签。评估明确区分了非 N/A 覆盖率、分析完成度、确定性安全决策、非安全发现和不支持结果等不同指标。实验结果表明，在带标签的家族中，ModelAudit 对全部 135 个家族（100%）给出了确定性安全决策，Fickling 覆盖 110 个（81.5%），而 ModelScan 仅覆盖 67 个（49.6%）。然而，在能够给出确定性判断的样本上，ModelScan 的精确率、召回率和 F1 均达到 100%。此外，Fickling 没有识别出任何独立于 ModelAudit 和 ModelScan 组合之外的唯一真阳性家族。值得注意的是，对于 ModelScan 未能完成分析的 48 个恶意家族，ModelAudit 和 Fickling 都产生了与真值一致的检测结果。这些发现强调了在评估安全扫描器时，应将判断准确性与判断可用性分开考量，同时也要区分增量检测覆盖率与工具级冗余。本文的核心贡献在于提出了一套更细致的评估指标，揭示了单纯依赖 F1 会严重高估某些扫描器的实际有效能力，为 AI 模型安全工具的选型和评估提供了方法论指导。适合安全工具评估人员、AI 供应链安全研究者和 ML 运维工程师阅读。

items.title: Low-ASR Backdoors: Exploiting Attack Success Rate Reduction and Attacker-Defender Asymmetry
items.summary: Backdoor attacks are among the most effective and stealthy attacks in deep learning. Existing attacks and defenses are largely designed and evaluated under the assumption that successful backdoors exhibit high Attack Success Rates (ASRs). In this paper, we show that this assumption creates a fundamental weakness in existing defense paradigms. ASR is not an intrinsic property of a backdoor; rather, it is an attacker-controlled variable that can be deliberately reduced without eliminating the underlying backdoor behavior. We introduce a reverse-training framework that weakens the trigger-target association, producing low-ASR backdoor models while preserving clean-input performance. Through extensive evaluation across multiple datasets, diverse attack families, and multiple architectures, we show that state-of-the-art defenses fail consistently under low-ASR conditions, exposing a fundamental attacker-defender asymmetry.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对深度学习中的后门攻击与防御展开研究，指出当前主流防御范式建立在一个隐含假设之上：成功的后门攻击必然具有较高的攻击成功率（ASR）。作者认为这一假设存在根本性缺陷，因为ASR并非后门的固有属性，而是攻击者可以主动控制的变量。通过刻意削弱触发器与目标标签之间的关联，攻击者能够在保留底层后门行为的同时，将ASR降至极低水平，从而规避依赖ASR阈值或高置信度触发检测的防御机制。为此，论文提出一种逆向训练框架，通过反向优化过程弱化特征与目标之间的映射强度，生成低ASR后门模型，同时保持模型在干净输入上的性能基本不受影响。作者在多个数据集、多种攻击家族和多种网络架构上进行了大量实验，证明现有最先进的防御方法在低ASR条件下均持续失效，揭示了攻击者与防御者之间天然的不对称性：防御者通常假设攻击会最大化ASR，而攻击者可以随意调整该指标以绕过检测。该工作拓展了后门攻击的威胁模型，表明低ASR后门更具隐蔽性，对现有防御评估基准提出了挑战。适合AI安全研究员、模型鲁棒性工程师和后门防御机制设计者阅读，用于重新思考后门检测的评估指标和防御策略。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究突破传统后门攻击的高ASR假设，揭示低ASR后门可系统性绕过现有防御，促使安全社区重新评估防御基准与检测逻辑，对AI模型供应链安全具有重要警示意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖ASR作为后门检测指标的安全产品与研究基准；可迁移至联邦学习、模型压缩等场景，加剧后门攻击的隐蔽性。
detection_signals_zh: 模型在干净样本上性能正常，但针对特定触发器存在异常低置信度输出

defense_advice_zh: 不应仅依赖ASR作为唯一后门检测指标，需结合神经通路分析、表征空间异常检测等无假设方法
在模型训练后增加触发器无关的鲁棒性验证，如随机噪声注入下的行为一致性
探索自适应防御机制，动态调整检测阈值以应对低ASR策略

items.title: X-WAD: eXplainable Web Anomaly Detection
items.summary: The rapid growth of web-based services, particularly API-driven architectures, reflects an increasing reliance on distributed systems, exposing sensitive data to security risks and making the adoption of automated defensive mechanisms essential. In this context, where benign traffic predominates in real-world settings, modern defenses increasingly model normal behavior, relying on semi-supervised approaches trained on only normal data. However, ensuring the complete absence of anomalous instances in such training data is inherently difficult in practice, and mislabeled or contaminated attack samples can introduce backdoors into the learned defense, causing the model to silently misclassify certain attack patterns as normal behavior. This paper investigates the effectiveness of Transformer-based Language Models (TLMs) in the detection of anomalies in HTTP requests, focussing on providing detailed explanations for the detected anomalies. The study employs token-level logit-based surprisal mapping to provide both an anomaly score and a direct, detailed explanation via heatmap-like highlighting. The effectiveness of the proposed explainability approach is demonstrated by the discovery of labelling inconsistencies in a popular public dataset, revealing how anomalous contamination in the training data had induced backdoor-like failures in the detection models.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究基于 Transformer 的语言模型（TLMs）在 HTTP 请求异常检测中的应用，并重点关注异常的可解释性。现实场景中良性流量占绝大多数，因此现代防御系统常采用半监督方法仅用正常数据训练模型来刻画正常行为。然而，完全保证训练数据中不含异常样本在实践中有难度，错误标注或受污染的样本可能会在模型中引入类似后门的缺陷，导致模型将某些攻击模式静默地误判为正常行为。本文提出 X-WAD（eXplainable Web Anomaly Detection）方法，利用基于 token 级 logit 的 surprisal（惊讶度）映射，既给出异常分数，又通过类似热力图的高亮方式提供直接、详细的异常解释。作者使用该可解释性方法发现了一个公开流行数据集中存在的标注不一致问题，证明了训练数据中的异常 contamination 确实会诱导检测模型出现类似后门的失败。该研究强调了可解释性不仅用于事后解释，还能作为诊断工具揭示训练数据污染与模型潜在缺陷。论文主要贡献包括：提出基于 TLM 的异常检测与 token 级解释框架，展示 surprisal 映射的有效性，并通过真实数据验证了数据污染对模型鲁棒性的危害。适合研究 Web 安全、异常检测、可解释 AI 以及对抗鲁棒性的学者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为蓝队提供可解释的Web异常检测方法，并能主动发现训练数据污染导致的模型后门缺陷。

items.title: Physical-Layer Fingerprint-Space Capacity Analysis for 100BASE-TX Devices in IIoT
items.summary: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) networks widely adopt Ethernet technologies, such as 100BASE-TX, for industrial communications. As industrial networks continue to scale, reliable device authentication becomes increasingly important for preventing device impersonation and unauthorized access. Physical-layer fingerprinting (PLF) exploits device-dependent fingerprint features in transmitted signals and provides a hardware-based approach for terminal authentication. However, the distinguishable space supported by 100BASE-TX physical-layer fingerprints and its capacity boundary remain largely unexplored. To analyze the capacity of physical-layer fingerprints, this paper proposes a nonlinear and impulse-response model (NAIM) that characterizes device-dependent waveform differences in 100BASE-TX transmitted waveforms. The nonlinear component captures steady-state level deviations, while the impulse-response component describes the transition response during level transitions. The 100BASE-TX transmitter waveform requirements, the observation resolution determined by noise and analog-to-digital conversion (ADC) quantization, and the target bit-error ratio (BER) constrain the admissible fingerprint space. Under the NAIM model, the fingerprint-space capacity of 100BASE-TX terminals is derived as approximately $2.96\times10^{10}$ distinguishable states. Experiments on signals collected from 48 NICs under two cable conditions estimate a Gaussian-equivalent empirical capacity from the measured inter-device and within-device variations. Under the 5-m cable condition, empirical capacity and closed-set identification consistently rank the three NIC models, and a larger empirical capacity yields higher identification accuracy. These results demonstrate that the proposed capacity analysis provides a pre-deployment assessment for physical-layer fingerprinting in IIoT.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对工业物联网（IIoT）中广泛使用的100BASE-TX以太网物理层指纹（PLF）容量问题展开研究。随着工业网络规模扩大，设备认证对于防止设备冒充与未授权访问至关重要，物理层指纹利用发射信号中与设备相关的硬件差异，提供基于硬件的终端认证手段。然而，关于100BASE-TX物理层指纹所能支持的可区分空间及其容量边界，此前尚未得到充分探索。为此，作者提出了一种非线性与脉冲响应模型（NAIM），用于刻画100BASE-TX发射波形中由设备引起的波形差异：非线性分量捕捉稳态电平的偏差，脉冲响应分量描述电平转换期间的瞬态响应。该模型将100BASE-TX发射机的波形要求、由噪声和模数转换（ADC）量化决定的观测分辨率，以及目标误比特率（BER）作为限制条件，从而界定可用的指纹空间。在NAIM模型下，推导出100BASE-TX终端的指纹空间容量约为2.96×10^10个可区分状态。实验部分从48张网卡（NIC）在两种电缆条件下采集信号，估计了高斯等效经验容量。在5米电缆条件下，经验容量与闭集识别结果一致地对三种NIC型号进行排序，且更大经验容量对应更高的识别准确率。实验结果表明，所提出的容量分析可为IIoT中物理层指纹的部署前评估提供依据。该研究为物理层设备认证的可行性提供了理论支撑，有助于安全人员理解指纹方案的极限与部署条件。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 物理层指纹是IIoT设备认证的重要补充技术，该论文首次量化了100BASE-TX的指纹容量边界，为安全工程师评估此类方案的实际可用性、避免误用或过度依赖提供了理论依据，同时为后续硬件级身份识别研究奠定基础。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该成果可迁移至基于以太网的工业控制、能源、交通等IIoT场景，用于设备身份鉴别、防冒充与物理层安全审计；也可为其他以太网速率（如1000BASE-T）的指纹容量分析提供参考。

items.title: SLIDE: Shuffle Shamir Secret Shares Uniformly with Linear Online Communication and Guaranteed Output Delivery
items.summary: We revisit shuffle protocols for Shamir secret sharing. Existing constructions either produce non-uniform shuffles or incur high communication and round complexity, sometimes exponential in the number of parties. We propose two new shuffle protocols that achieve uniform shuffling with communication complexity $O((k+l)n^2m\log m/\log k)$ for an $m$-by-$l$ matrix shared among $n$ parties, where $k\leq m$ is a tunable parameter. The first protocol is concretely efficient, while the second achieves the best-known $O(nml)$ online communication and $O(n)$ rounds. Experiments show significant improvements in online efficiency and total cost over prior work. Our key technical ingredient is a novel permutation sharing technique that represents permutations using smaller permutation matrices, making their application significantly more efficient. The first protocol applies independent secret permutations sequentially, while the second builds on shuffle correlation to achieve optimal online complexity. We further extend shuffle correlation to support guaranteed output delivery with linear online communication, yielding SLIDE, the first protocol to achieve both $O(nml)$ online communication and guaranteed output delivery. Our constructions rely only on basic Shamir secret sharing over any field of size greater than $n$. As shuffling is a fundamental primitive for MPC tasks such as sorting and oblivious data structures, our results enable more efficient and scalable secure computation in practice.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文重新审视了Shamir秘密共享中的洗牌（shuffle）协议。洗牌是一种对共享矩阵的行进行随机置换的原语，广泛应用于安全多方计算（MPC）中的排序、不透明数据结构和隐私保护数据操作。现有洗牌构造要么产生非均匀的排列（即不是从所有排列中均匀随机选择），要么通信开销和轮复杂度较高，部分方案甚至随参与方数量呈指数增长。作者提出两种新的洗牌协议，均能实现均匀洗牌，并将通信复杂度降至O((k+l)n^2m log m / log k)，其中n为参与方数，m×l为共享矩阵的规模，k≤m为可调参数。第一个协议在具体实现上更高效，适合一般场景；第二个协议则实现了目前已知最优的在线通信复杂度O(nml)，且轮数为O(n)。实验结果表明，这两种协议在在线效率和总成本上均显著优于现有方案。关键技术贡献是一种新颖的排列共享技术：通过将排列表示为多个较小的排列矩阵，使得排列的应用（即对矩阵行进行重排）在通信和计算上更加高效。第一个协议顺序应用多个独立的秘密排列，而第二个协议利用“洗牌关联”构造来达到最优在线复杂度。作者进一步将洗牌关联扩展为支持“保证输出交付”（guaranteed output delivery），即在即使有恶意参与方但未退出（或称为主动安全）的模型中，协议也必然产生正确结果，且不牺牲线性在线通信。由此得到SLIDE协议，这是首个同时实现O(nml)在线通信和保证输出交付的均匀洗牌方案。构造仅基于标准Shamir秘密共享，且对任意大于参与方数的域均成立，不依赖其他密码学假设。由于洗牌是排序、不透明数据结构等MPC基础任务的关键原语，该成果直接提升了安全计算的实际效率，并使更大规模的安全计算部署成为可能。本文适合MPC协议设计者、安全计算系统开发者以及对隐私增强技术感兴趣的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 洗牌是安全多方计算中排序、不透明数据结构等高级任务的核心原语，改进其通信复杂度直接影响大规模安全计算的效率与可扩展性。该研究同时提供理论最优与具体高效的双重方案，且首次达到线性在线通信与保证输出交付，值得MPC协议设计者和应用安全工程师关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到需要安全洗牌的场景，如安全排序、隐私保护数据库查询、匿名通信等；此外SLIDE首次同时实现线性在线通信与保证输出交付，可降低实际部署中故障处理的开销，提升系统鲁棒性。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: SecureDrive-FL: Joint Differential Privacy and Gradient-Aware Selective Homomorphic Encryption for Federated Driver Monitoring
items.summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-aware distributed training, yet gradient updates remain exploitable: Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) interception exposes updates in transit, while model poisoning corrupts global convergence. We first introduce GASHE (Gradient-Aware Selective Homomorphic Encryption), a novel selective encryption strategy that dynamically identifies and encrypts only the gradient components exceeding a DP-calibrated sensitivity threshold, rather than encrypting all parameters uniformly as in static layer-based or full-parameter CKKS schemes. Building on GASHE, we introduce SecureDrive-FL, a federated driver monitoring framework that couples DP-SGD with GASHE to create the first closed-loop DP+HE privacy pipeline: DP-SGD calibration parameters directly derive the GASHE encryption mask, unifying training-time privacy and communication-time confidentiality. Evaluated on a ten-class distracted driver classification task under non-IID federated splits, SecureDrive-FL matches DP-SGD alone's poisoning resistance (73.6% vs. 74.0% accuracy, 3.9% Attack Success Rate for both) while additionally withstanding MitM interception, where DP-SGD alone collapses to near-random accuracy (78.2% vs. 10.4%), all under only approx. 8--10% additional runtime overhead relative to DP-SGD alone---under DP-SGD noise injection with per-round privacy parameter epsilon_0=4.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 联邦学习（FL）通过分布式训练在一定程度上保护原始数据，但梯度更新仍面临严重隐私威胁：中间人（MitM）攻击可窃听传输中的梯度，而模型投毒攻击会破坏全局模型的收敛性。针对这些问题，本文提出了一种全新的选择性加密策略 GASHE（Gradient-Aware Selective Homomorphic Encryption），它动态识别梯度分量，仅对超过 DP（差分隐私）校准敏感度阈值的部分进行同态加密，而不是像传统静态分层或全参数 CKKS 方案那样对所有参数统一加密。基于 GASHE，作者进一步构建了 SecureDrive-FL，一个面向联邦驾驶员监控的框架，将 DP-SGD 与 GASHE 紧密耦合，形成了第一个闭环的 DP+HE 隐私流水线：DP-SGD 的校准参数直接推导出 GASHE 的加密掩码，从而统一了训练时的隐私保护与通信时的机密性保障。实验在非独立同分布（non-IID）联邦划分的十类分心驾驶员分类任务上进行，结果表明 SecureDrive-FL 在抗投毒能力上与单独使用 DP-SGD 相当（准确率 73.6% 对 74.0%，攻击成功率均为 3.9%），同时还能抵御 MitM 窃听——在 MitM 攻击下，单独使用 DP-SGD 的准确率骤降至接近随机的 10.4%，而 SecureDrive-FL 仍保持 78.2% 的准确率。此外，相对于单独使用 DP-SGD，SecureDrive-FL 仅带来约 8%–10% 的额外运行时开销，且每轮隐私参数 ε₀=4。本文的主要贡献在于提出了动态、自适应的梯度选择性加密机制，并通过实验验证了其在隐私保护与计算开销之间的良好权衡，为联邦学习在实时、资源受限场景（如车载监控）中的实用化提供了新思路。适合关注隐私增强技术、联邦学习安全以及边缘 AI 系统部署的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作解决了联邦学习梯度传输中面临的实际隐私威胁，提出一种将差分隐私与同态加密动态结合的新方法，在几乎不增加开销的情况下显著提升抗窃听能力，对车载监控、医疗等隐私敏感型联邦学习应用具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响联邦学习系统中隐私保护的设计范式，可迁移到任何包含梯度交互的分布式机器学习场景，尤其是对通信带宽和时延有严格要求的边缘计算环境。

items.title: Cyber-Electromagnetic Anomaly Detection Through Time-Series Analysis
items.summary: Military operations benefit from the coordination between kinetic and non-kinetic domains. In particular, the coordination of cyber operations and electromagnetic warfare has become increasingly relevant for gaining operational advantage. This coordination is also relevant for Cyber Situational Awareness (CSA), where the Observe-Orient-Decide-Act (OODA) loop requires monitoring and interpreting evidence from heterogeneous sources. In this context, anomalies may appear not only in the physical behavior of signals, but also in the communication behavior observed at the traffic level. However, many existing anomaly detection proposals focus on only one of these perspectives, limiting their ability to characterize events that manifest simultaneously in the electromagnetic spectrum and cyberspace. To address this limitation, this work develops and evaluates two anomaly detection models that combine features from both domains. More specifically, the study uses the ZBDS2023 dataset, which contains traffic from nodes in a mesh network, including benign and attack behaviors. Thus, this dataset provides physical-level features, traffic-level features, and labeled attacks. Two detection approaches are evaluated: a supervised model based on Random Forest and an unsupervised model using LSTM-Autoencoder. The results show that learning-based models can detect patterns combining both levels, especially under a supervised approach, achieving an F1-score of 89.76% with Random Forest and 64.09% with LSTM-Autoencoder. Although these results indicate that the proposed models can support CSA by improving the observation and interpretation of anomalous behavior, the subtle differences between normal and attack samples highlight the need for richer discriminative features.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文聚焦于军事行动中网络域与电磁战域的协同问题，提出利用时间序列分析实现网络-电磁异常检测，以增强网络态势感知（CSA）能力。研究背景指出，现代军事行动需要协调动能与非动能域，特别是网络操作与电磁战的配合，对于获取作战优势至关重要。在OODA（观察-定向-决策-行动）循环中，需要监控并解释来自异构源的证据，而异常可能同时体现在信号物理行为和流量通信行为中。然而，现有异常检测方案大多只关注单一视角，难以刻画同时在电磁频谱和网络空间表现的事件。为弥补这一不足，作者开发并评估了两种结合两个域特征的异常检测模型。研究使用ZBDS2023数据集，该数据集包含网状网络节点的流量，包括良性行为和攻击行为，并提供物理层特征、流量层特征及攻击标签。两种检测方法被评估：基于随机森林的有监督模型和基于LSTM自编码器的无监督模型。实验结果表明，基于学习的模型能够检测结合两个层面的模式，尤其是监督方法表现更优：随机森林的F1分数达到89.76%，LSTM自编码器为64.09%。尽管这些结果说明所提模型能通过改进异常行为的观察和解释来支持CSA，但正常样本与攻击样本之间的细微差异表明需要更丰富的判别特征。该研究的核心贡献在于提出并验证了融合电磁频谱与网络流量特征的多域异常检测方法，为网络-电磁协同态势感知提供了可行方案。读者对象适合军事网络安全研究人员、电磁战分析人员以及从事多域安全态势感知的工程师。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文创新性地融合电磁与网络流量特征进行异常检测，切合军事场景下跨域协同需求，为蓝队理解多域攻击提供了新视角，有望提升综合态势感知能力。

items.title: Neighborhood Watch: Privacy Risks in Seeded Local Combination Synthetic Data
items.summary: Synthetic data is seen as a promising solution for sharing data in sensitive contexts. However, recent work on privacy attacks have shown that there are still significant residual risks, especially for synthetic data generations methods that are not based on formal approaches such as differential privacy. In this paper, we investigate the privacy risks associated with local combination approaches for generating synthetic data in which synthetic profiles are built by combining real neighbouring profiles. More precisely, we focus on three methods from this family, namely SMOTE, Simulant and Avatar, which have been recently used as a way to share 'anonymised data' in the healthcare domain. In particular, we conduct an extensive privacy analysis through a diverse set of attacks: membership inference, linkage and reconstruction attacks. Our results demonstrate substantial privacy leakage for all three methods, raising serious doubts about whether their outputs should be regarded as anonymous in practice.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对合成数据生成中的隐私风险展开研究，重点关注基于局部组合（local combination）的合成数据方法。这类方法通过组合真实邻近样本来构建合成档案，常见于医疗等敏感领域的数据共享场景。作者选取了 SMOTE、Simulant 和 Avatar 三种代表性方法，系统性地评估了它们在成员推断攻击、链接攻击和重建攻击下的隐私泄露程度。实验结果表明，这三种方法均存在显著的隐私泄露风险，其输出在实践上难以被视为真正的匿名数据。该研究揭示了即使未采用差分隐私等正式隐私保护机制，局部组合方法仍可能残留大量可被利用的隐私信息，对依赖此类方法进行数据共享的机构构成严重威胁。论文通过多种攻击手段的全面分析，为合成数据的安全评估提供了实证依据，并警示相关从业者重新审视这类方法的匿名性承诺。适合隐私保护研究者、合成数据开发者以及医疗等敏感领域的数据治理人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 合成数据常被当作隐私保护方案，但本研究证明 SMOTE 等局部组合方法存在严重隐私泄露。对此类方法有依赖的企业需警惕，其输出可能被攻击者恢复敏感信息。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用 SMOTE、Simulant 或 Avatar 生成合成数据的医疗、金融等场景，可能导致成员推断、属性泄露或记录重建。

items.title: A Catalog of User Authentication Patterns
items.summary: Security patterns are intended to support the design and development of secure software systems. However, although established catalogs of security patterns exist, their practical application remains limited. In particular, despite these catalogs, concrete patterns for common security controls such as user authentication (authentication for short) are lacking. This paper aims to make an initial contribution toward closing this gap, as exemplified by authentication. It presents a novel authentication pattern catalog, comprising 14 user authentication patterns. To support the catalog's practical application, it classifies patterns by the well-known concept of authentication factors and by the usual role each pattern fulfills in practice. By cataloging common authentication techniques through authentication patterns, we aim to make an important contribution to supporting software engineers and architects in designing and developing secure software systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对安全模式目录在实际软件工程中应用不足的问题，以用户认证为切入点，提出了一套全新的认证模式目录。作者指出，尽管已有多种安全模式目录，但具体到常见安全控制（如用户认证）的详细模式仍然缺失，导致软件工程师和架构师难以将安全知识直接应用于系统设计。为解决这一缺口，论文系统性地梳理了常见的用户认证技术，并将其抽象为14种用户认证模式。为了提升目录的实用性，作者采用两个维度对模式进行分类：一是广为人知的认证因素（如知识、拥有、生物特征等），二是每种模式在实践中的典型角色（如验证者、凭证管理、会话管理等）。该目录旨在为软件工程师和架构师提供一种结构化的参考，帮助他们在设计认证机制时能够更系统地选择和应用合适的模式，从而降低安全漏洞风险。论文的主要贡献在于：首次提出了一个专门针对用户认证的细化模式目录，弥补了现有安全模式目录在该领域的空白；通过结合认证因素和角色分类，增强了模式的可查找性和可用性；为安全模式研究提供了从抽象安全概念到具体实现技术的桥梁。适合软件工程师、安全架构师以及安全模式研究人员阅读，尤其适合在具体认证功能设计时作为参考指南。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为认证设计提供结构化模式目录，帮助蓝队在评审或架构设计时快速识别认证弱点，并对照常见模式进行加固。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于身份认证系统的设计评审、安全架构文档编写、以及开发人员安全培训等场景，属于安全设计阶段的实用参考。

items.title: FIDA: Feature Instability-Driven Attack on Self-Supervised Facial Representation
items.summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) models are vulnerable to backdoor attacks. However, the systemic risks they pose in face representation have received little attention. The entanglement of identity features in self-supervised face learning presents unique challenges for attack stealthiness. To address this gap, we propose FIDA (Feature Instability-Driven Attack), a novel backdoor attack framework. FIDA uses subtle semantic triggers for injection, but its key innovation is a novel objective called Feature Instability Loss. It trains the encoder to increase the sensitivity of triggered features along perturbation directions sampled during attack optimization . By preventing the backdoor from exhibiting the rigid feature patterns typical of previous attacks, FIDA effectively evades the evaluated perturbation-based defenses. Experiments show that FIDA achieves a high attack success rate and generally preserves benign utility across the evaluated settings , posing a significant threat to real-world multimedia applications relying on facial analysis.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种针对自监督学习（SSL）人脸表示模型的后门攻击框架 FIDA（Feature Instability-Driven Attack）。研究背景在于，尽管自监督学习模型已被证实容易受到后门攻击，但在人脸表示领域，这类攻击的系统性风险尚未得到充分关注。自监督人脸学习中身份特征的高度纠缠性给攻击的隐蔽性带来了独特挑战。为填补这一空白，作者设计了 FIDA，其核心创新在于一种名为“特征不稳定性损失”（Feature Instability Loss）的新颖训练目标。与使用固定或刚性触发模式的传统后门攻击不同，FIDA 在攻击优化过程中，沿着采样的扰动方向训练编码器，使触发后的特征对这些扰动变得敏感，从而避免后门表现出以往攻击中常见的刚性特征模式，以此有效规避基于扰动的防御检测。实验结果表明，FIDA 在多种评估设置下均能取得较高的攻击成功率，同时基本保持良性样本的效用不下降，对人脸分析相关的现实多媒体应用构成了显著威胁。该论文属于攻击研究，适合从事人脸识别系统安全、自监督模型鲁棒性研究以及防御机制设计的研究人员和蓝队成员阅读，以理解此类隐蔽后门攻击的原理并提前规划防御策略。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示自监督人脸表示模型存在新型隐蔽后门攻击风险，攻击特征不稳定可绕过常见扰动防御，威胁人脸识别等多媒体应用安全，蓝队需关注此类攻击范式。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响依赖自监督人脸表示的下游应用，如人脸验证、识别、属性分析等；攻击可被植入到预训练编码器中，造成广泛间接危害。
detection_signals_zh: 模型对特定语义触发（subtle semantic triggers）表现出异常敏感的特征变化
在扰动方向下特征敏感性分布与良性模型存在统计差异
后门触发特征缺乏传统刚性模式，需使用动态或统计检测方法
defense_advice_zh: 对自监督预训练模型进行后门检测时，使用更广泛的扰动空间和动态特征分析，而非仅依赖固定模式
在模型部署前进行对抗性触发重放和特征分布一致性验证
对训练数据与训练过程实施更严格的供应链审计，防止恶意预训练权重注入

items.title: Information Flow Control in Off-Chain Components
items.summary: This paper develops a model of a smart-contract language for a blockchain architecture with off-chain components. Off-chain components are pieces of smart contracts that execute at designated locations outside of the network of blockchain nodes, but remain synchronised with the on-chain contract state. They react to changes to the on-chain state, but may also notify the on-chain component about events in the world, e.g. stock prices, weather data etc., or even act as a bridge between different blockchains. This affords greater flexibility for the developer, but may also enable new vulnerabilities. As a concrete example, we use the model to study the problem of ensuring integrity and secrecy of data between the on-chain and off-chain components, using static information flow control techniques. This fails, even in the absence of a loop construct, because off-chain components act as separate threads and can encode a blocking construct e.g. through recursive method calls. We end the paper with a discussion of possible ways to remedy this situation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对具有链下组件的区块链智能合约架构，提出了一种形式化建模方法。链下组件是智能合约的一部分，它们在区块链节点网络之外指定的位置执行，但保持与链上合约状态同步。它们既能响应链上状态变化，也可以向链上环节报告外部世界事件（如股价、天气数据等），甚至能充当不同区块链之间的桥接器。这种设计虽然提升了开发灵活性，但也引入了新的安全风险。论文将链下组件建模为独立线程，利用静态信息流控制技术来研究链上与链下组件之间数据的完整性与机密性保障问题。研究发现，即便在没有循环结构的情况下，由于链下组件可充当独立线程并通过递归方法调用等机制隐式编码阻塞结构，传统的信息流控制方法在此场景下会失效。这表明链下组件为攻击者提供了新的信息泄露或完整性破坏途径。最后，论文讨论了若干潜在的补救方向，如改进类型系统、引入显式的并发控制或限制链下组件的通信能力等。该研究为区块链安全分析提供了新的模型基础，对设计安全的链下组件具有理论指导意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 链下组件正越来越多地用于跨链桥、预言机等关键基础设施，其安全属性直接关系到资产安全。该论文揭示了即使没有循环结构，静态信息流控制也无法保证数据机密性和完整性，这一发现对基于链下组件的DApp设计与审计具有重要警示作用。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响范围包括所有采用链下组件架构的区块链应用，尤其是使用原生链上-链下通信的跨链桥、去中心化预言机（如价格馈送）、条件支付等场景。
defense_advice_zh: 在设计链下合约时，尽量避免复杂递归调用，以防止隐式阻塞结构被利用。
对链下组件的通信行为实施严格权限控制与访问管理。
引入运行时监控，检测链下组件与链上交互中的异常信息流。
在关键场景中考虑使用形式化验证工具对链下组件进行安全分析。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Daydreaming: Stealing Hidden Agent Skills through Black-Box Task Interaction
items.summary: Agent skills bundle instructions, reference data, and executable helpers that let a general agent perform specialized tasks. Hosted providers can keep these files secret while selling access to task results, making the skill itself a valuable target. Existing disclosure defenses can block requests that ask for the skill or reproduce its text, but they cannot block customers from submitting the ordinary tasks the service is built to complete. We present Daydreaming, an execution-only attack that steals a multi-file skill through black-box task interactions. The victim is never asked to reveal the skill or grade a reconstruction. Instead, Daydreaming adaptively creates crafted tasks whose results distinguish possible hidden behaviors. It tests individual behaviors, uses attacker-controlled shadow agents to choose a design, and completes each file using stored victim results and local execution checks. We formalize three nested threat levels of access as Differential, Trace, and Output, and focus on Output, where the attacker sees only the final response and returned files. Across 7 skills and 4 victim models, Daydreaming recovers 86.8% of the original skill's capability at Output, outperforming SigLeak by almost 4x. It produces installable skills using a median of 32 victim calls per skill even with disclosure defenses enabled. These results show that hiding skill files and filtering direct disclosure do not, by themselves, prevent functional reconstruction through normal use.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种名为 Daydreaming 的黑盒任务交互攻击方法，旨在从托管代理服务中窃取隐藏的“技能”（agent skills）。技能通常包含指令、参考数据和可执行的辅助文件，使通用代理能够执行专业任务。托管提供商可以对这些文件保密，仅向用户出售任务结果访问权限，因此技能本身具有高价值。现有的披露防御机制可以阻止直接请求技能内容或复现其文本的查询，但无法阻止用户提交服务本身构建的常规任务。Daydreaming 利用这一缺口，仅通过黑盒任务交互来窃取多文件技能。攻击不要求受害者显式揭示技能或对重建结果进行评分，而是自适应地设计任务，使返回结果能区分可能的隐藏行为。具体而言，该方法逐一测试行为，使用攻击者控制的影子代理选择设计，并通过存储的受害者结果和本地执行检查来补全每个文件。作者形式化了三种嵌套的访问威胁级别：Differential、Trace 和 Output，并重点研究 Output 级别——攻击者只能看到最终响应和返回文件。在 7 个技能和 4 个受害者模型上，Daydreaming 在 Output 级别恢复了原始技能能力的 86.8%，比 SigLeak 方法高近 4 倍。即使启用了披露防御，每个技能也仅需中位数 32 次受害者调用即可生成可安装的技能。实验证明，隐藏技能文件和过滤直接披露本身并不能防止通过正常使用进行的功能重建。该研究揭示了代理服务中秘密技能保护的新漏洞，提示需要新型防御机制来抵御基于任务结果的推理攻击。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了仅靠隐藏技能文件和过滤直接披露无法防止功能窃取，对依赖秘密技能的代理服务构成实际威胁，安全从业者需关注此类推理式攻击对业务模型和数据资产的潜在风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有以技能为知识产权的托管代理服务，攻击者可通过合法任务接口逆向出完整技能，导致商业机密泄露。
detection_signals_zh: 对同一代理提交大量异常且精心设计的任务序列
任务输入与输出特征与正常业务模式存在显著偏差
多次调用且结果被用于重建痕迹（如本地校验行为）
defense_advice_zh: 对任务结果进行扰动或粒度控制
监控并限制单用户的任务调用频率与模式
对高价值技能增加感知重建攻击的检测模型
使用水印或差异化输出来追踪泄露
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进
